    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s.replace("ﬁ", "fi").replace("ﬂ", "fl")).strip()

with open("screening_46/results/batch_08.json") as f:
    orig = json.load(f)

for rid in ["C22", "C23", "C24", "SNCS"]:
    txt = open(f"screening_46/text/{rid}.txt").read()
    pages = {}
    parts = re.split(r"=== PDF PAGE (\d+) ===", txt)
    for i in range(1, len(parts), 2):
        pages[int(parts[i])] = norm(parts[i+1])
    rec = [r for r in orig["records"] if r["id"] == rid][0]
    checks = [("identity", rec["identity_evidence"])] + [(k, v) for k, v in rec["gates"].items()] + [("alignment", rec["alignment"])]
    for name, obj in checks:

        q = obj["quote"]
        wc = len(q.split())

print("C22-C23:", len(c22 & c23), sorted(c22 & c23))

print("C23-C24:", len(c23 & c24), sorted(c23 & c24))
